line: Bitcoin is holding flat while spot ETFs saw outflows; the news is mixed, led by the courts.

wire_top3.line: NYSE chose Avalanche as the settlement ledger for its planned 24/7 tokenized stock trading platform.
The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted Coinbase a full national trust bank charter, enabling expansion of its institutional custody business.
North Korean hackers tied to the $6.3 billion Binance hack created six memecoins on NEAR to move about $430,000 in stolen funds, Elliptic reported.
